  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds: card issuing and IP countries differ and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The applicable row is §6.6(b), but the completed failed id_check now decides under §5.3(b): decline, not escalate, because Linkage is absent. A gift purchase plausibly explains the new non-home address, but longstanding device and card use cannot override the failed check. The order is unshipped. Recommend decline and account blocking; no further check is needed."
